lines: 计算机不认识猫这个字，它只认识数字。
A computer does not know the word cat. It only knows numbers.
所以表示学习的第一步，是给每个词一个数字分身。
So the first step in representation learning is a numeric stand-in for every word.
最直接的做法：给词表里的每个词编一个号。
The simplest approach: assign an index to every word in the vocabulary.
编号展开成向量，就是 one-hot 编码。
Unfold that index into a vector and you have one-hot encoding.
这一章讲：词怎么变成向量，又从静态走向动态。
This chapter covers how words become vectors, and how vectors became dynamic.
它决定了大模型第一层能看到什么。
It decides what the first layer of a large model can see.
先看最笨的办法：五万个词，就编五万个号。
Start with the dumbest method: fifty thousand words, fifty thousand IDs.
每个词是一个五万维向量，只有一位是一。
Each word becomes a fifty-thousand-dimensional vector with a single one.
第一个毛病：维度爆炸，几乎全是零。
Problem one: the dimension explodes, and almost every entry is zero.
第二个毛病更致命：任意两个词的内积都是零。
Problem two is worse: the dot product of any two words is zero.
在模型眼里，猫和狗的差距，等于猫和车的差距。
To the model, cat-to-dog equals cat-to-car.
第 1 章的 n-gram 就死在这里：它表达不了相似。
The n-grams of Chapter 1 died here: they cannot express similarity.
那怎么定义意义？语言学家弗斯给了一句座右铭。
So how do we define meaning? The linguist Firth left a motto.
观其伴，知其义：看它常和谁一起出现。
You shall know a word by the company it keeps.
猫常和喵、鱼、毛一起出现，车常和油、轮胎一起出现。
Cat appears with meow, fish and fur; car with fuel and tires.
没有词典，只看朋友圈，也能猜个八九不离十。
Without a dictionary, its circle of companions gives it away.
更早的说法是分布式假设：上下文相似，意义相似。
The earlier claim is the distributional hypothesis: similar contexts, similar meaning.
注意这只是统计倾向，不是定义。
This is a statistical tendency, not a definition.
既然意义等于上下文，就训练模型去预测上下文。
If meaning equals context, train a model to predict context.
2013 年，米科洛夫等人在谷歌提出 word2vec。
In 2013, Mikolov and colleagues at Google proposed word2vec.
两种玩法：CBOW 看周围猜中间，Skip-gram 反过来。
Two variants: CBOW predicts the center, Skip-gram goes the other way.
训练完成后，中间那层词向量，就是词义。
After training, the vectors in the middle layer are the meanings.
目标函数让窗口内邻居的对数概率之和最大。
The objective maximizes the log probability of neighbors in the window.
每个词最后得到一个一百到三百维的稠密向量。
Each word ends up with a dense vector of one to three hundred dimensions.
比五万维稀疏向量，小了两个数量级。
That is two orders of magnitude smaller than a fifty-thousand-dimensional vector.
训练好之后，神奇的事发生了。
After training, something remarkable happens.
国王减去男人，加上女人，最接近女王。
King minus man plus woman lands closest to queen.
巴黎减法国加意大利，最接近罗马。
Paris minus France plus Italy lands closest to Rome.
性别是一个方向，国别是另一个方向。
Gender is one direction; nationality is another.
语义关系，变成了向量空间里的位移。
Semantic relations become displacements in vector space.
但这是近似，不是定律，依赖训练细节。
But this is approximate, not a law, and it depends on training details.
可 softmax 要对整个词表求和，太慢了。
But softmax sums over the whole vocabulary, which is far too slow.
负采样把多分类，改成二分类。
Negative sampling turns the multiclass problem into binary classification.
正样本是真实出现的词对，标签一。
Positive pairs really co-occurred; they get label one.
负样本是随机抽的词，标签零。
Negatives are random words; they get label zero.
计算量从词表大小 V，降到采样数 k。
Compute drops from vocabulary size V to k samples.
不追求精确，追求足够好，再加上十倍速度。
Not exact, just good enough, at ten times the speed.
为什么预测上下文，能学到语义？
Why does predicting context teach meaning?
把它想成一个约束系统。
Picture it as a constraint system.
猫和狗的上下文高度重叠，模型必须给相似的向量。
Cat and dog share contexts, so their vectors must be close.
否则同一套参数没法预测相似上下文，损失会变大。
Otherwise one parameter set cannot predict both, and the loss grows.
于是梯度下降，把上下文相似压成了向量相近。
Gradient descent compresses similar contexts into nearby vectors.
没人告诉模型猫和狗是动物，结构是自己长出来的。
Nobody told the model that cats and dogs are animals; the structure grew.
这就是表示学习：不手工设计特征，让模型自己学。
That is representation learning: no hand-built features, the model learns.
还有个前置问题：词到底是谁定的？
One prerequisite remains: who decides what a word is?
按空格切？中文没空格，英文一个词变几种形式。
Split on spaces? Chinese has none, and English inflects one word many ways.
现代方案是子词：把词切成更小的片段。
The modern answer is subwords: cut words into smaller pieces.
BPE 像压缩：初始拆成字符，反复合并最高频的相邻对。
BPE works like compression: start from characters, merge the most frequent pair.
合并到目标词表大小，比如五万或十二万八千。
Keep merging until the vocabulary hits a target, say fifty thousand or 128k.
高频片段早早成为 token，罕见词被拆成几段。
Frequent chunks become tokens early; rare words split into common pieces.
字节级 BPE 以字节为单位，永不 OOV。
Byte-level BPE uses bytes, so any text encodes and nothing is OOV.
word2vec 有个根本局限：每个词只有一个向量。
word2vec has a fundamental limit: one vector per word.
吃苹果和苹果发布会，苹果的意思不同。
Apple the fruit and Apple the company are different meanings.
bank 在河岸和银行里，也是两个意思。
Bank by a river and bank for money are two senses as well.
静态向量只能取折中，把两个意思平均掉。
A static vector can only compromise and average them.
上下文相关表示，让整个句子过一遍网络。
Contextual representations pass the whole sentence through a network.
2018 年 ELMo 用双向 LSTM，BERT 用 Transformer。
ELMo used a bidirectional LSTM in 2018; BERT used a Transformer.
表示不再是从词典查出来的，而是算出来的。
Representation is no longer looked up. It is computed.
工程上，嵌入就是一个矩阵。
In engineering, an embedding is just a matrix.
每一行是一个 token 的向量，查表就是取一行。
One row per token; lookup takes a row.
V 是词表大小，d 是隐藏维度，矩阵是可训练参数。
V is vocabulary size, d is hidden size, and the matrix is trained.
很多模型让输入嵌入和输出层共享权重。
Many models tie the input embedding to the output layer.
GPT-3 的 d 是一万二千二百八十八，约六点二亿参数。
GPT-3 uses d equal to 12,288, about 620 million parameters.
光查字典这一层，就比 2012 年的整个 AlexNet 大。
This lookup layer alone is bigger than all of AlexNet in 2012.
还有一维被词袋丢掉了：顺序。
One dimension is still missing from the bag of words: order.
猫追狗和狗追猫，词一样，意思相反。
Cat chases dog and dog chases cat use the same words, opposite meaning.
把词向量求平均，两句话的表示完全相同。
Average the word vectors and both sentences become identical.
解决办法是位置编码：把第几个词也变成向量。
The fix is positional encoding: turn the position into a vector too.
最早用不同频率的正弦、余弦函数生成。
The earliest version used sine and cosine functions of different frequencies.
好处是相对位置能算出来，模型能学会往右看三个词。
Relative positions become computable, so the model can look three words right.
后来有可学习位置和 RoPE，细节留到第 5 章。
Later came learned positions and RoPE; details wait for Chapter 5.
表示学习留下了遗产，也留下了陷阱。
Representation learning left a legacy, and also traps.
第一，相似不等于同义：医生和护士向量近，角色不同。
First, similar is not synonymous: doctor and nurse are close but different.
第二，偏见会被编码：语料的性别倾向会被继承和放大。
Second, bias gets encoded and amplified from the corpus.
第三，各向异性：真实向量挤在锥形区域，余弦不可靠。
Third, anisotropy: real vectors crowd a cone, so cosine similarity misleads.
第四，静态和动态要分清：查表向量不是某一层的激活。
Fourth, keep static and dynamic apart: a lookup vector is not an activation.
所以看到词向量三个字，先问：哪一种？
So when you see the word vector, first ask: which kind?
这一章之后，词已经是向量，还带上了位置。
After this chapter, words are vectors, and they carry position.
但向量之间，还没有互相看的关系。
But the vectors still do not look at each other.
下一章从循环网络讲到注意力。
Next: from recurrent networks to attention.
模型怎么记住前文，又怎么挑重点。
How a model remembers context and chooses what matters.
那是 Transformer 之前必须跨过的一道坎。
That is the step you must cross before the Transformer.
